messages:
carla_sales: @jon_customer_sec quick vendor-risk ask — the prospect needs access control evidence for their SIG review. specifically they asked for: MFA enforcement proof, SAML IdP metadata, RBAC role mapping examples, and a short least-privilege statement. deadline is end of week. can we deliver?

alex_se: we can. want to confirm whether they want org-level screenshots or per-team tenant views? also will they accept redacted screenshots + signed attestation?

jon_customer_sec: redacted screenshots + signed attestation is fine. they also prefer machine-readable metadata (SAML XML) and a sample API response for role listings.

tara_security: fyi on controls we can include: enforcement of MFA for all console users, default admin separation, and scoped service accounts for infra. i can produce redacted screenshots of the console policy page and an attestation PDF.

alex_se: below are the artifacts we can bundle:
- SAML metadata (XML)
- SSO config steps for Okta/Azure AD
- MFA policy screenshot (redacted)
- RBAC role export (sample JSON)
- Example audit log lines showing admin role changes
- Signed attestation from security (pdf)

tara_security: sample SAML metadata snippet we can include (redacted):
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://console.redwood.ai/saml">
  <IDPSSODescriptor/>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

alex_se: sample API curl to pull roles (we'll provide a sanitized response):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/orgs/ORG_ID/roles
```

lisa_legal: two notes — (1) we should include a short cover letter explaining redactions and a contact for follow-ups, (2) any attestation/pdf needs to be approved by legal before signing. i can review today.

jon_customer_sec: perfect. they also asked whether we enforce MFA for service accounts or only human users — they want clarity on automation accounts.

tara_security: we don't enforce interactive MFA for machine-to-machine service accounts. instead we require scoped API keys with limited scopes, rotate keys routinely, and recommend using short-lived tokens via our delegated service token flow. we'll add a snippet explaining key rotation and scope enforcement.

carla_sales: timeline check — can we have the bundle uploaded by EOD Thursday? prospect wants to route to procurement Friday.

tara_security: i can produce screenshots + attestation by Thursday morning.

alex_se: i'll prepare the role export and sanitize it, plus a README explaining least-privilege mappings.

lisa_legal: i will review the attestation by Thursday noon.

deploy-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/1778654321-id-access-evidence-v1.zip (redacted metadata, attestation pending legal review) :package:

carla_sales: awesome — i'll confirm with the prospect that redacted screenshots + signed attestation + machine-readable SAML/roles are ok. thanks team :raised_hands:
